info.title: Smart Bhumi Seba Backend — implementation contract
info.description: DESIGN ONLY. Not deployed. Synthetic P5 prototype. Every response no-store. Sessions obtained using supported Supabase Auth SDK; no custom password endpoint. Staff import/provisioning are trusted CLI operations, not public HTTP routes.

post.description: Reject client outcome/owner fields. First response 201, replay 200 with same report ID and snapshot; different body under same owner/key 409. Server pins published data/version and rule version. Shared quota applies.

post.summary: Create validated draft; owner/client ID uniquely identifies intent
post.description: Duplicate same client_draft_id and body for owner returns existing draft 200; changed body returns 409. Updates use PATCH with revision.
